(section) Section 1 (21-2-221(a)); struck words ("shall") and new words ("may") run together in the print
(quote) "(a) Each application to obtain, renew, or change the name or address on a driver's license or identification card issued by the Department of Driver Services pursuant to Chapter 5 of Title 40 made by an applicant who is within six months of such applicant's eighteenth birthday or older shall may, if eligible, also serve as an application for voter registration unless the applicant declines to register to vote through specific declination or by failing to sign the voter registration application. The applicant may sign the voter registration application to register to vote or to update the voter's registration if the voter has changed his or her address."
(other) Section 2: repeal of conflicting laws (no other subject)
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
